title: Storage capacity in Turing's 1950 paper, in binary digits
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. Turing's three-state clicking wheel: about 1.6 binary digits. The Manchester computer in 1950: 174,380. A human computer's 100 sheets of 50 lines of 30 digits: about 498,000. Turing's prediction for about the year 2000: about 1,000,000,000 (10 to the 9th). Data: Turing 1950, sections 5 and 6.
heading: STORAGE CAPACITY · BINARY DIGITS (LOG SCALE)
